title: agg wiki lint result, schema_version 1
description: `agg wiki lint [PATH] --json`: OKF v0.2 conformance of a knowledge wiki (default: the project's agg/state/wiki/). Exit 0 when `ok`, 1 on any problem or when PATH does not exist. Read-only: the lint writes nothing.

ok.description: no problems; warnings do not count

exists.description: false when the default wiki does not exist yet (then ok is true and nothing was checked)

files.description: markdown files checked, index.md and log.md included

concepts.description: of those, concept documents (every .md that is not a reserved filename)

warnings.description: producer guidance (OKF §5) that a consumer must not reject a concept over

line.description: 1-based; null when the finding is about the file or a frontmatter key

rule.description: a stable rule id, e.g. frontmatter.missing, type.empty, index.entry, log.order, status.unknown
